title: A Flexible Empirical Bayes Approach to Generalized Linear Models, with Applications to Sparse Logistic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2601.21217v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a flexible empirical Bayes approach for fitting Bayesian generalized linear models. Specifically, we adopt a novel mean-field variational inference (VI) method and the prior is estimated within the VI algorithm, making the method tuning-free. Unlike traditional VI methods that optimize the posterior density function, our approach directly optimizes the posterior mean and prior parameters. This formulation reduces the number of parameters to optimize and enables the use of scalable algorithms such as L-BFGS and stochastic gradient descent. Furthermore, our method automatically determines the optimal posterior based on the prior and likelihood, distinguishing it from existing VI methods that often assume a Gaussian variational. translated_title: 一种灵活的广义线性模型经验贝叶斯方法，及其在稀疏逻辑回归中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.21217v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了一种灵活的贝叶斯广义线性模型拟合的经验贝叶斯方法。具体而言，我们采用了一种新颖的均值场变分推断（VI）方法，并在VI算法中估计先验，使得该方法无需调参。与传统的优化后验密度函数的VI方法不同，我们的方法直接优化后验均值和先验参数。这种表述减少了需要优化的参数数量，并使得诸如L-BFGS和随机梯度下降等可扩展算法得以使用。此外，我们的方法根据先验和似然自动确定最优后验，这区别于现有通常假设高斯变分的VI方法。我们的方法代表了一个适用于广泛指数族分布的统一框架，无需为每种似然和先验组合开发独特的VI方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需调参的灵活经验贝叶斯变分推断方法，直接优化后验均值与先验参数，统一适用于各类指数族分布，并在稀疏逻辑回归中表现出高效性和自动性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tuning-free flexible empirical Bayes variational inference method that directly optimizes posterior means and prior parameters, providing a unified framework for exponential family distributions and demonstrating effectiveness in sparse logistic regression.
